title: Situation Capsule Elicitation
description: Interview a human and their documents into a review-gated model of what is happening, what is contested, and what decision the capsule serves.

stages.title: Decision Served
question_templates: What decision, briefing, negotiation, or analysis should this situation capsule support?
What would make the capsule unusable for that decision?
completion_criteria: At least one misuse condition is named.

stages.title: Actors And Interests
question_templates: Who are the actors that matter?
What does each actor want, fear, control, or owe?

follow_up_hints.trigger: one side of the conflict has no actor
follow_up_hints.prompt: Who would object to this framing?

stages.title: Contested Claims
question_templates: What claims are disputed or uncertain?
Which facts can be asserted, attributed, hedged, or only treated as questions?

stages.title: Time Window
question_templates: What is the relevant time window?
Which deadlines, sequences, or stale facts change the analysis?
completion_criteria: At least one temporal risk is named.

criteria.description: At least four relevant actors or institutions are captured.
At least six source-bound claims are proposed.
At least two temporal episodes or decision moments are captured.
